subject: general
question: A borrows a sum of Rs.3,500 for 6 years at 5% p.a. simple interest. He lends it to B at 9% p.a. for 3 years. What is his gain or loss?
solution:
Formula:

SI = (P x R x T) ÷ 100

Where-

P = Principal amount

R = Rate

T = Time

SI = Simple Int
